## Purpose
Implements the user-scoped `/api/settings` router: GitHub PAT storage/validation, long-lived API-key issuance/revocation, AI model preference, and the user's Constitution (a persistent guardrail injected into every governed agent's prompt).

## Shape
- GitHub PAT endpoints (`upsert_github_pat`/`get_github_pat_status`/`delete_github_pat`) — validate the PAT against `GET /user` on GitHub before persisting it encrypted (`encrypt_pat`/`decrypt_pat`).
- API key endpoints (`create_api_key`/`list_api_keys`/`revoke_api_key`) — mint/list/revoke hashed long-lived keys via `mint_api_key`.
- Preferences endpoints (`get_preferences`/`update_preferences`) — read/write `user.preferred_model`, validated against `AVAILABLE_MODELS`/`_VALID_MODEL_IDS`, both derived from `ModelCatalog()` (module-level constants, computed once at import).
- Constitution endpoints (`get_constitution`/`set_constitution`/`delete_constitution`) — proxy to `agents.workflow_memory.memory.get_workflow_memory()`.

## Why this shape
The module docstring states these endpoints deliberately require the standard interactive-login JWT rather than accepting the PAT/API-key credentials they manage as their own auth, to avoid a credential-laundering vector; `AVAILABLE_MODELS`/`_VALID_MODEL_IDS` are explicitly a derived projection over the single `ModelCatalog` source of truth rather than a second hand-maintained list.
